summary: Wednesday's hotter-than-forecast core PCE (3.3%) cemented a priced-in December Fed hike, new tariff proposals up to 20% and an AI chip sell-off hit the Nasdaq; Asia rebounded on Thanksgiving while US markets were shut, and Friday is a thin early-close US session.
events_next_24h: Sat 05:00 USD US stock market early close after Thanksgiving (thin liquidity)

ES.why: Hot core PCE locked in a December Fed hike and new tariffs loom, while funds sit crowded long (94th pct), leaving room to unwind.
ES.risk: A holiday-thin squeeze higher or softer Fed talk flips it.

NQ.why: AI chip sell-off (Nvidia -3.9%) plus a priced Fed hike weigh on tech; Nasdaq is down about 12% in 20 days and VXN is near 1-year highs.
NQ.risk: Thursday's Asian tech rebound carrying into a thin US session.

YM.why: Dow closed up 0.33% after erasing a 1,100-point drop, showing rotation into value even as the macro tone is hawkish.
YM.risk: A renewed broad sell-off would drag it lower.

RTY.why: Small caps rose 0.78% Wednesday on rotation, but Fed hikes are a headwind for rate-sensitive small firms.
RTY.risk: Higher yields after the hike pricing hurt small caps.

NKD.why: Nikkei bounced 0.9% Thursday but is down 9% in 20 days; Tokyo CPI at 10:30 and BOJ hike talk keep the picture mixed.
NKD.risk: A hot Tokyo CPI or yen spike would pressure it.

6J.why: Wide US-Japan rate gap pushes the yen weaker, but USD/JPY at 159.3 sits just under Tokyo's 160 intervention line.
6J.risk: Intervention or a hot Tokyo CPI would send 6J sharply higher.

6E.why: Fed hike pricing supports the dollar, but the move is fully priced and EU tariff threat is already known.
6E.risk: A fresh dollar breakout would push 6E lower.

6B.why: No fresh UK catalyst found; dollar strength from Fed hike bets is offset by fading momentum.
6B.risk: A strong dollar move after the holiday.

6A.why: Risk mood is mixed after the AI sell-off and Asia rebound; no Australian catalyst found.
6A.risk: A risk-off turn in tech would hit the Aussie.

ZN.why: Hot core PCE and hike pricing argue lower bonds, but haven buying pulled the 10-year yield down to 4.85%.
ZN.risk: Strong data next week ahead of NFP.

GC.why: A priced Fed hike and firm dollar weigh on gold near one-year lows; funds are leaning short (20th pct), not yet crowded.
GC.risk: A geopolitical shock or Fed wobble sparks a short squeeze.

CL.why: Hormuz tanker attacks lifted WTI 2.5% to $84, and funds are crowded short (10th pct), which is fuel for a squeeze higher.
CL.risk: Ceasefire or peace headlines, or a big inventory build.
